test_dashboard_landing_loads.title: Verify the Insights dashboard landing page loads successfully

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Insights page opens and lists the System Status preset.

test_all_insights_tab_visible.title: Verify the All Insights tab is visible on the dashboard

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The All Insights tab is shown at the top of the page.

test_preset_dashboard_section_visible.title: Verify the landing shows its sections and the preset entry

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The page shows the My Dashboards and Widgets tabs and lists System Status as the preset dashboard.

test_preset_dashboard_cards_displayed.title: Verify the preset dashboard is listed as a link on the landing

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: System Status is listed and is a link to the system status dashboard.

test_preset_dashboard_view_all.title: Verify the View All control is visible on the landing

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: A View All control is shown next to the dashboard list.

test_preset_card_clickable.title: Verify clicking the preset entry opens the System Status dashboard

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then click System Status.
steps.expected: The System Status dashboard opens and shows the Devices and Cameras panels.

test_my_dashboard_section_visible.title: Verify the My Dashboards tab is visible on the landing

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The My Dashboards tab is shown.

test_my_dashboard_view_all.title: Verify View All keeps the user on the landing when there is nothing more to list

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then click View All.
steps.expected: The page stays on the Insights landing and the Create New button is still shown.

test_create_new_button_visible.title: Verify the Create New button is visible on the landing

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: A Create New button is shown above the dashboard list.

test_create_dashboard_opens_form.title: Verify clicking Create New opens the dashboard creation screen

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then Create New.
steps.expected: The Create New Dashboard screen opens with a Dashboard Name field and an Add a widget picker.

test_create_dashboard_has_discard_and_sa.title: Verify Discard and Save buttons are shown on the creation screen

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then Create New.
steps.expected: The creation screen shows a Discard button and a Save button.

test_create_dashboard_name_field.title: Verify the Dashboard Name field accepts a name

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then Create New.
steps.expected: The creation screen shows an empty Dashboard Name field.

steps.action: Type a name into the field.
steps.expected: The field shows the typed name.

test_save_disabled_without_name.title: Verify Save stays disabled until the dashboard has a name and a widget

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then Create New.
Type a dashboard name without adding a widget.
steps.expected: The Save button is still disabled.

test_insights_page_scrollable.title: Verify the Insights landing survives scrolling

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, scroll down and back up.
steps.expected: The page stays on Insights and the System Status preset is still listed.

test_dashboard_page_after_refresh.title: Verify the Insights landing loads again after a browser refresh

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then refresh the browser.
steps.expected: The Insights landing loads again and lists the System Status preset.
